rules.v: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights
rules.vi: Hukum ketenagakerjaan umum berlaku, atau undang-undang khusus memberi hak-hak intinya
rules.n: Provincial employment standards cover domestic workers in most provinces (Ontario as reference).

rules.f: Written contract in a language understood
rules.fi: Kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang dipahami
rules.v: Written contract required and provided in a language the worker understands
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis wajib dan tersedia dalam bahasa yang dipahami pekerja
rules.n: Employment contract required for the work permit.
rules.s: Immigration and Refugee Protection Regulations s. 209.2

rules.v: Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
rules.vi: Upah minimum menurut undang-undang berlaku sama dengan pekerja lain

rules.v: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
rules.vi: Pembayaran minimal bulanan, terdokumentasi, dengan batas potongan atau upah natura

rules.v: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
rules.vi: Hanya aturan istirahat harian, atau batas lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
rules.n: Overtime rules apply with some provincial exceptions.

rules.v: At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
rules.vi: Minimal 24 jam berturut-turut, tidak dapat diganti uang atas permintaan pemberi kerja

rules.v: Equal to or longer than for other workers
rules.vi: Sama atau lebih panjang dari pekerja lain

rules.f: Keeping own identity and travel documents
rules.fi: Memegang dokumen identitas dan perjalanan sendiri
rules.v: Express right, or retention by employers prohibited with a penalty
rules.vi: Hak tegas, atau penahanan oleh pemberi kerja dilarang dengan sanksi
rules.n: Employers may not take a foreign worker's passport or work permit (Ontario).
rules.s: Employment Protection for Foreign Nationals Act 2009

rules.v: Worker may choose to live out; live-in accommodation must be decent and private
rules.vi: Pekerja boleh memilih tinggal di luar; akomodasi di rumah harus layak dan privat

rules.v: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
rules.vi: Pindah hanya dalam keadaan tertentu atau setelah syarat terpenuhi
rules.n: Caregiver pilots gave occupation-specific permits; other streams are employer-specific.

rules.v: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
rules.vi: Pekerja tidak boleh dibebani biaya rekrutmen
rules.n: Employers must ensure no recruitment fees are charged; provincial bans.

rules.vi: Hanya berdasarkan pengaduan atau pengawasan agen

rules.v: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
rules.vi: Pengadilan atau tribunal ketenagakerjaan setara pekerja lain, atau tanpa biaya

rules.v: Included in the general social security system, including maternity
rules.vi: Termasuk dalam sistem jaminan sosial umum, termasuk kehamilan
rules.n: Canada Pension Plan and Employment Insurance.

rules.f: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
rules.v: General criminal or civil law only
rules.vi: Hanya hukum pidana atau perdata umum

rules.v: Restricted (excluded from collective bargaining law, or may join but not form)
rules.vi: Dibatasi (dikecualikan dari hukum perundingan bersama, atau boleh bergabung tetapi tidak membentuk)
rules.n: Some provinces exclude domestic workers from labor relations law.

decisions.pe: A woman from Grenada living in Canada without status was refused health coverage when she was seriously ill. The UN Human Rights Committee said this put her life at risk and broke the treaty.
decisions.pi: Seorang perempuan dari Grenada yang tinggal di Kanada tanpa status ditolak jaminan kesehatan saat sakit parah. Komite HAM PBB menyatakan ini membahayakan nyawanya dan melanggar perjanjian.

decisions.nm: Singh v. Minister of Employment and Immigration
decisions.pe: Sikh refugee claimants were refused without ever being heard in person. The Supreme Court said everyone in Canada has the right to life, liberty and security, and they must get a hearing.
decisions.pi: Pemohon status pengungsi Sikh ditolak tanpa pernah didengar langsung. MA menyatakan setiap orang di Kanada berhak atas hidup, kebebasan, dan keamanan, dan mereka harus disidangkan.

decisions.nm: Andrews v. Law Society of British Columbia
decisions.pe: A British lawyer living permanently in Canada was barred from practising law because he was not a citizen. The Supreme Court said this was discrimination.
decisions.pi: Seorang pengacara Inggris yang tinggal tetap di Kanada dilarang berpraktik karena bukan warga negara. MA menyatakan ini diskriminasi.

decisions.nm: Baker v. Canada (Minister of Citizenship and Immigration)
decisions.pe: A Jamaican woman who had worked for years as a live-in domestic worker faced deportation, leaving behind her four Canadian-born children. The Supreme Court said officials must take the children’s interests seriously.
decisions.pi: Seorang perempuan Jamaika yang bertahun-tahun menjadi pekerja rumah tangga tinggal di rumah majikan akan dideportasi, meninggalkan empat anaknya yang lahir di Kanada. MA menyatakan pejabat wajib serius menimbang kepentingan anak-anak.

decisions.nm: Suresh v. Canada (Minister of Citizenship and Immigration)
decisions.pe: A Sri Lankan refugee was ordered deported as a security risk although he might be tortured. The Supreme Court said this would generally be unconstitutional and sent the case back.
decisions.pi: Seorang pengungsi Sri Lanka diperintahkan dideportasi sebagai risiko keamanan meski bisa disiksa. MA menyatakan ini umumnya inkonstitusional dan mengembalikan perkaranya.

decisions.pe: Non-citizens were held for years on secret evidence they could not see. The Supreme Court struck down the procedure and required prompt reviews of detention.
decisions.pi: Bukan warga negara ditahan bertahun-tahun berdasarkan bukti rahasia yang tidak bisa mereka lihat. MA membatalkan prosedur itu dan mewajibkan peninjauan penahanan yang cepat.

decisions.pe: Ontario farm workers, many of them seasonal migrants, had no legal protection to form unions. The Supreme Court said total exclusion was unconstitutional.
decisions.pi: Pekerja pertanian Ontario, banyak di antaranya migran musiman, tidak punya perlindungan hukum untuk membentuk serikat. MA menyatakan pengecualian total itu inkonstitusional.

decisions.pe: After Dunmore, Ontario passed a law letting farm workers form associations but not bargain collectively like other workers. The Supreme Court upheld it.
decisions.pi: Setelah Dunmore, Ontario membuat UU yang membolehkan pekerja pertanian membentuk perkumpulan tetapi tidak berunding bersama seperti pekerja lain. MA mempertahankan UU itu.

decisions.pe: A Tamil teenager who fled Sri Lanka asked to stay on humanitarian grounds and was refused. The Supreme Court said officials had looked at his case too narrowly.
decisions.pi: Seorang remaja Tamil yang melarikan diri dari Sri Lanka meminta tetap tinggal atas alasan kemanusiaan dan ditolak. MA menyatakan pejabat memeriksa perkaranya terlalu sempit.

decisions.nm: Canadian Council for Refugees v. Canada (Safe Third Country Agreement)
decisions.pe: People turned back at the US border argued they faced detention and refoulement in the US. The Supreme Court upheld the scheme for now but sent the gender-discrimination argument back.
decisions.pi: Orang yang ditolak di perbatasan AS berpendapat mereka akan ditahan dan dipulangkan di AS. MA mempertahankan skema itu untuk sementara tetapi mengembalikan argumen diskriminasi gender.

decisions.pe: A woman from Grenada without status in Canada was refused health coverage while seriously ill. The Canadian courts rejected her claim. The UN Human Rights Committee later found Canada in breach.
decisions.pi: Seorang perempuan dari Grenada tanpa status di Kanada ditolak jaminan kesehatan saat sakit parah. Pengadilan Kanada menolak gugatannya. Komite HAM PBB kemudian menyatakan Kanada melanggar.

decisions.pe: Deportation of a young man raised in Canada to Somalia.
decisions.pi: Deportasi pemuda yang dibesarkan di Kanada ke Somalia.

decisions.nm: Canada (Minister of Employment and Immigration) v. Chiarelli
decisions.pe: Deportation of a permanent resident after a serious conviction.
decisions.pi: Deportasi penduduk tetap setelah vonis berat.

decisions.pe: Loss of appeal rights for permanent residents facing removal.
decisions.pi: Hilangnya hak banding penduduk tetap yang akan dikeluarkan.

decisions.pe: Extradition of refugees and non-refoulement.
decisions.pi: Ekstradisi pengungsi dan non-refoulement.

decisions.pe: Exclusion from refugee protection for complicity in crimes.
decisions.pi: Pengecualian dari perlindungan pengungsi karena keterlibatan dalam kejahatan.

decisions.pe: Exclusion of refugees for serious non-political crimes.
decisions.pi: Pengecualian pengungsi karena kejahatan serius non-politik.

decisions.pe: Mutual aid among asylum seekers is not people smuggling.
decisions.pi: Saling bantu antarpencari suaka bukan penyelundupan manusia.

decisions.pe: Overbreadth of the human smuggling offence.
decisions.pi: Terlalu luasnya tindak pidana penyelundupan manusia.

decisions.pe: Inadmissibility for violent acts and judicial review standards.
decisions.pi: Tidak dapat diterimanya karena tindakan kekerasan dan standar peninjauan.

decisions.nm: John Doe et al. v. Canada
decisions.pe: Asylum seekers arriving from the United States were 'directed back' there to wait for their hearings and some were then removed by the United States. The Commission held that a state may not return a claimant to a third country whose law bars their asylum claim without an individual assessment. Comparator (North…
decisions.pi: Pencari suaka yang datang dari Amerika Serikat 'dikembalikan' ke sana untuk menunggu sidang, dan sebagian kemudian dipulangkan oleh AS. Komisi menyatakan negara tidak boleh mengembalikan pemohon ke negara ketiga yang hukumnya menghalangi permohonan suakanya tanpa penilaian individual. Pembanding.

help.de: Free legal advice and representation for caregivers and other migrant workers on employment and immigration problems, by phone, video or WhatsApp.
help.di: Nasihat dan pendampingan hukum gratis bagi pengasuh dan pekerja migran lain untuk masalah kerja dan imigrasi, lewat telepon, video atau WhatsApp.

help.nm: Service Canada tip line for temporary foreign workers
help.de: Report abuse by an employer of a temporary foreign worker, in over 200 languages. The employer is not told who reported. In danger, call 911.
help.di: Laporkan penyalahgunaan oleh majikan pekerja asing sementara, dalam lebih dari 200 bahasa. Majikan tidak diberi tahu siapa pelapornya. Jika dalam bahaya, hubungi 911.

help.de: Organization of migrant farmworkers, care workers and students. Call, text or email; help in English, French, Hindi, Korean, Portuguese, Spanish, Tagalog and Urdu.
help.di: Organisasi buruh tani migran, pengasuh dan pelajar. Hubungi lewat telepon, SMS atau email; bantuan dalam bahasa Inggris, Prancis, Hindi, Korea, Portugis, Spanyol, Tagalog dan Urdu.
